title: Auto Claim - First Notice of Loss
subtitle: Phone claim intake recorded by Contoso Insurance claims representative

sections.heading: Loss details
fields: County Road 22 near Riverton Falls, OR

sections.heading: What happened (as stated by the caller)
sections.paragraph: Caller states they were driving east in the left lane of County Road 22 when a red hatchback in the right lane moved into their lane without signaling. The hatchback scraped along the right side of the caller's SUV from the front wheel back across both right doors before both drivers pulled over. The right mirror was knocked loose and is hanging by its wires. Caller reports a loud grinding sound against the front wheel at the moment of contact. No one was injured. A Riverton Falls police officer came to the scene and gave both drivers a report number.

sections.heading: Damage to your vehicle
fields: Right front door; Right rear door; Right side mirror
Caller describes scrapes and dents along the right side starting at the front wheel and running back across both right doors, with the lower door trim scraped; right mirror knocked loose.
Did the vehicle have damage before this incident that has not been repaired?
